about: Indi's list of everything left to do, drawn as the infographic at /people/indi/todo/. The Command Centre half is rebuilt from the board and the stand-up items at every release; this file adds a next step per issue and the tasks that are not on the board. Kept by dashboard@web-summit.indi at each run, from 4 November at Indi's word (first written by synthetic@web-summit.indi from the board, Indi's briefs 1 to 8 and that day's git log).
